description: Represents single tab inside `v-tabs`. Wrapper of `v-btn`.

props.direction: Changes the direction of the tabs. Can be either `horizontal` or `vertical`.
props.hideSlider: Hides the active tab slider component (no exit or enter animation).
props.inset: Changes the slider to take full height. Automatically propagated from VTabs.
props.fixed: Forces component to take up all available space up to their maximum width (300px), and centers it.
props.sliderColor: Applies specified color to the slider when active on that component - supports utility colors (for example `success` or `purple`) or css color (`#033` or `rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)`). Find a list of built-in classes on the [colors page](/styles/colors#material-colors).
props.sliderVariant: Shape of the active tab slider. `primary` follows the Material Design 3 primary tab — a thicker slider with rounded leading corners, sized to the tab content instead of the whole tab. Ignored when `inset` is set.
props.sliderTransition: Changes slider transition to one of the predefined animation presets.
props.sliderTransitionDuration: Applies custom slider transition duration. Default duration depends on transition type (fade: 400, grow: 350, shift: 225).
props.stacked: Displays the tab as a flex-column.
